hobbies that will make you
disgustingly intelligent

map roulette

pick a random place on a map every week and learn three things about it. the world gets bigger, and so does every conversation you have.

ten hard pages

read ten pages a day of a book that feels slightly too hard. the struggle is the workout, and after a month the hard books start feeling normal.

why chains

ask "why" five times about one thing you believe. most opinions collapse by the third why, and the ones that survive are actually yours.

five minutes of history

spend 5 minutes a day on one moment from history: a revolution, an invention, a forgotten queen. people who know where things come from understand where they're going.

coffee teaching

explain one thing you learned this week to a friend over coffee. watching their face tells you instantly which parts you actually understood.
